use_case: Electric load-forecasting model: hourly day-ahead and 7-day forecasts for the system and each of the 74 substations, plus the 150 MW solar PPA output
business_owner: Director of Power Supply and Rates
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted regression model in the analytics account (SYS-09); retrained monthly
data_categories: Historian replica feeder and substation loads; AMI interval data aggregated to at least 100 meters; weather forecasts; calendar; rooftop solar estimates (no individual customer records)
affects_individuals: No (indirect: errors land on neighborhoods served by under-forecast substations)
human_in_the_loop: Lead Load Forecasting Analyst reviews each run; Director of Power Supply and Rates approves the day-ahead schedule; Director of System Operations approves peak-day operating plans for substations within 5% of their limits
applicable_laws: None AI-specific; wholesale supply contract (schedule deadlines and imbalance charges); POL-04 for usage data; NERC CIP not applicable (not a BES Cyber System)
status: In production since 2023-04; approved with conditions 2026-09-17

use_case: AMI theft and tamper analytics: flags meters with patterns that suggest tampering or theft of service for field investigation
vendor_or_model: AMI vendor analytics module (statistical and machine learning anomaly scores)
data_categories: Interval usage, meter events (tamper, reverse flow, outage), account history
consequential_decision_category: None directly; re-tier to High if flags lead to disconnection or back-billing without field verification
human_in_the_loop: A revenue protection technician inspects every flagged meter before any action; back-billing needs supervisor approval
applicable_laws: State tariff rules on back-billing and disconnection (not assessed here); POL-04; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production since 2024-09; approved with conditions 2026-09-17

use_case: Contact center generative AI agent assistant: suggests answers and summarizes calls for customer and client utility agents
vendor_or_model: Contact center platform vendor feature using a third-party large language model (model provider carved out of the vendor SOC 2)
data_categories: Call audio and transcripts; account details shown to agents (names, addresses, balances, payment arrangements); knowledge articles
consequential_decision_category: None directly (agent decides); re-tier if it advises on disconnection, payment arrangements, or credit without agent review
human_in_the_loop: Agents must confirm any suggested answer against the knowledge article shown before acting; summaries edited by the agent
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (reasonable security for personal information); 16 CFR 681.1(e)(4) (service provider oversight for covered accounts); Utility Services client contracts; NIST AI 600-1 (voluntary)
status: In production since 2026-05 (enabled without review); approved with conditions 2026-09-17

use_case: Vegetation risk model: ranks circuit miles by tree-contact outage risk to prioritize trimming cycles
vendor_or_model: Vendor model run on satellite imagery and outage history, delivered as a scored GIS layer
data_categories: Imagery; outage history by circuit; species and growth data; GIS feeder maps (no customer data)
human_in_the_loop: Vegetation planners review the ranking and set work plans; field arborists verify before trimming
applicable_laws: None AI-specific; state vegetation management and storm hardening plans (not assessed here)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite: drafting, summarizing, and searching company documents
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor assistant under enterprise data protection terms
data_categories: Email, documents, chat available to each user (inherits the user's permissions); may include customer data, CEII, and relay settings if permissions are too broad
human_in_the_loop: Users must check output before use (POL-05 4.8)
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); 18 CFR 388.113 handling of CEII (POL-04 5.6); NIST AI 600-1 (voluntary)
status: Pilot with 120 users since 2026-06; approved with conditions 2026-09-17

use_case: Deposit risk score: scores new residential applicants from consumer report data to set whether a deposit is required and its amount
vendor_or_model: CIS vendor scoring module using consumer report attributes and internal payment history
data_categories: Consumer report attributes; prior utility payment history; SSN for matching
human_in_the_loop: Credit staff can override; customers can ask for review; adverse action letters sent when a deposit is required based on the consumer report
applicable_laws: FCRA adverse action notice (15 U.S.C. 1681m(a)); ECOA (15 U.S.C. 1691) non-discrimination; 16 CFR 681.1 (Red Flags at account opening); 16 CFR 682.3 (disposal of consumer information); counsel to confirm which Regulation B provisions apply to public utility credit
status: In production since 2022-03; approved with conditions 2026-09-17
